stories.title: Implement State-to-Medical-Board Lookup Normalization
stories.description: Extend provider_detail_service to normalize provider state information and map it to the correct state medical board URL template, supporting consistent generation of disciplinary lookup links across all supported states.

stories.title: Handle Missing or Unsupported State Board Scenarios
stories.description: Implement fallback logic when a provider’s state does not have a predefined medical board link, returning a null-safe disciplinary signal with a clear 'not available' indicator while preserving contract integrity.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Disciplinary Signal Edge Cases
stories.description: Add unit tests covering edge cases including missing state data, unsupported states, malformed provider records, and verification that only indicator-level data (no detailed disciplinary records) is ever returned.
